name: Windows Subsystem For Linux
description: Windows MDM settings in the Windows Subsystem For Linux category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Allow custom kernel configuration
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables custom kernel configuration via .wslconfig (wsl2.kernel). This policy only applies to Store WSL.

properties.name: Allow custom networking configuration
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables custom networking configuration via .wslconfig (wsl2.networkingMode). This policy only applies to Store WSL.

properties.name: Allow custom system distribution configuration
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables custom system distribution configuration via .wslconfig (wsl2.systemDistro). This policy only applies to Store WSL.

properties.name: Allow kernel command line configuration
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables kernel command line configuration via .wslconfig (wsl2.kernelCommandLine). This policy only applies to Store WSL.

properties.name: Allow kernel debugging
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables kernel debugging configuration via .wslconfig (wsl2.kernelDebugPort). This policy only applies to Store WSL.

properties.name: Allow nested virtualization
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables nested virtualization configuration via .wslconfig (wsl2.nestedVirtualization). This policy only applies to Store WSL.

properties.name: Allow passthrough disk mount
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables passthrough disk mounting in WSL2 (wsl.exe --mount). This policy only applies to Store WSL.

properties.name: Allow the debug shell
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables the debug shell (wsl.exe --debug-shell). This policy only applies to Store WSL.

properties.name: Allow the Inbox version of the Windows Subsystem for Linux
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables the inbox version (optional component) of the Windows Subsystem for Linux. If this policy is disabled, only the store version of WSL can be used.

properties.name: Allow the Windows Subsystem for Linux
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables access to running Linux distributions in the Windows Subsystem for Linux for all users on the machine.

properties.name: Allow user setting firewall configuration
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables firewall configuration via .wslconfig (wsl2.firewall). This policy only applies to Store WSL.

properties.name: Allow WSL1
properties.description: When set to disabled, this policy disables WSL1. When disabled, only WSL2 distributions can be used.

properties.name: Configure default networking mode
properties.description: This policy specifies the default networking mode to be used for WSL2.
